limits: Descriptive matched seed/nudge summaries, not independent-world inference. Draws share prefixes; trajectories diverge across rules. Per-age rates omit draws with zero alive ticks for that age. Care starts/endings and total work/travel do not isolate displaced care time. Ground items and remaining body contents are separate; ledger spoilage records body losses. The rules121 baseline has no carcass mechanic. Null nutrition accounting means the flow observer was absent, not zero intake. Empty immediate hunger is not necessarily starvation damage when paid reserves cover the deficit. No universal benefit claim.
